en/recipes/apple-rice-bowl.title: Apple & Rice Comfort Bowl
en/recipes/apple-rice-bowl.excerpt: A light vegan bowl — steamed rice, sautéed apples, and water-based syrup. Pantry-friendly and gently sweet.

ingredients.note: for rice and a light apple glaze

steps.body: Rinse rice; cook in water until tender and fluffy.
In a pan, soften apple slices with a splash of water until glossy.
Spoon rice into bowls; top with warm apples and any pan juices.

en/recipes/gulf-chicken-rice.title: Gulf-Style Chicken & Rice
en/recipes/gulf-chicken-rice.excerpt: Simple one-pot Gulf comfort — chicken, basmati, butter, and plenty of water for fluffy grains.

ingredients.note: finish with a knob of butter

steps.body: Boil chicken with salt and whole spices until tender; strain and keep the broth.
Parboil rice in the broth until halfway done; drain.
Layer chicken and rice; steam on low with butter until fluffy.
Fluff and serve with bread or a simple salad.

en/recipes/kuwaiti-egg-breakfast.title: Kuwaiti Egg & Bread Breakfast
en/recipes/kuwaiti-egg-breakfast.excerpt: A quick vegetarian start — soft eggs, warm Arabic bread, and butter. Add cheese or tomatoes if you like.

steps.body: Warm bread wrapped in a clean towel or low oven.
Melt butter; scramble eggs with a splash of milk until just set.
Serve eggs over or beside bread; season with salt and black pepper.

en/recipes/machboos.title: Kuwaiti Chicken Machboos
en/recipes/machboos.excerpt: Fragrant baharat rice with tender chicken, dried lime, and ghee — a Friday and Ramadan classic.

steps.body: Pat chicken dry; season with salt, baharat, and turmeric.
Brown chicken in ghee with dried lime until golden on all sides.
Add water, simmer until chicken is cooked; remove and reserve stock.
Cook rinsed rice in the stock until absorbed; rest covered 10 minutes.
Top rice with chicken; serve with Arabic bread and daqoos if you like.

en/recipes/margoog.title: Margoog (Vegetable Stew)
en/recipes/margoog.excerpt: Slow-cooked stew under a thin bread lid — vegetables, chicken, and spices soak into soft flatbread.

ingredients.note: diced firm fruit — stand-in for root veg

steps.body: Brown chicken lightly; layer with diced vegetables and baharat in a heavy pot.
Add water and milk; bring to a gentle simmer.
Cover with overlapping bread sheets; brush or dot with butter.
Cook on low until bread softens and absorbs the juices.
Rest 5 minutes; tear bread into the stew and serve hot.

en/recipes/sayadiya.title: Sayadiya Rice with Spiced Fish Style
en/recipes/sayadiya.excerpt: Caramelized onion rice with deep spice — serve with fried fish when you have it; pantry version uses chicken.

steps.body: Slowly caramelize sliced onion in butter until deep brown; set half aside for garnish.
Season chicken (or fish) with baharat and cumin; fry until cooked through.
Deglaze onion pot with water; simmer into a fragrant stock.
Cook drained rice in the stock until tender and separated.
Plate rice, top with protein and reserved onions; serve with bread.

ar/recipes/gulf-chicken-rice.title: دجاج وأرز على الطريقة الخليجية
ar/recipes/gulf-chicken-rice.excerpt: راحة خليجية بسيطة في قدر واحد — دجاج وبسمتي وزبدة وماء وفير لحبات هشة.

steps.body: اسلق الدجاج مع الملح والبهارات الصحيحة حتى يلين؛ صفِّ واحتفظ بالمرق.
اسلق الأرز نصف نضج في المرق؛ صفِّه.
رتّب الدجاج والأرز؛ بخّر على نار هادئة مع الزبدة حتى يهش.
فكّك الحبات وقدّم مع الخبز أو سلطة بسيطة.

ar/recipes/machboos.title: مجبوس دجاج كويتي
ar/recipes/machboos.excerpt: أرز معطر بالبهارات مع دجاج طري واللومي والسمن — كلاسيكي الجمعة ورمضان.

steps.body: جفّف الدجاج؛ تبّله بالملح والبهارات والكركم.
حمّر الدجاج في السمن مع اللومي حتى يذهب لونه من كل الجهات.
أضف الماء واتركه يطبخ؛ ارفع الدجاج واحتفظ بالمرق.
اطبخ الأرز في المرق حتى ينضج؛ اتركه مغطى ١٠ دقائق.
ضع الدجاج فوق الأرز؛ قدّم مع الخبز العربي والدقوس إن رغبت.

ar/recipes/sayadiya.title: صيادية سمك
ar/recipes/sayadiya.excerpt: أرز بصل مكرمل ببهارات عميقة — قدّم مع سمك مقلي إن توفر؛ النسخة المخزنية بالدجاج.

steps.body: كرمل البصل ببطء في الزبدة حتى يصبح بنياً غامقاً؛ احتفظ بنصفه للتزيين.
تبّل الدجاج (أو السمك) بالبهارات والكمون؛ اقليه حتى ينضج.
أضف الماء لقدر البصل؛ اتركه يفور لمرق عطري.
اطبخ الأرز المصفي في المرق حتى ينضج ويتفكك.
قدّم الأرز مع البروتين والبصل المحفوظ؛ مع الخبز.
